items.information: Välkomna till Örebro Vinterkubing - Side Events! Självklart är alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Notera att de mer populära grenarna kommer köras dagen innan denna tävling i en annan lokal, se mer information i fliken [Örebro Vinterkubing - Main Events.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OrebroVinterkubingSideEvents2025#64743-orebro-vinterkubing-main-events) Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Örebro Vinterkubing - Side Events! Everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Please note that the more popular events will be held the day before this competition in a different venue, see more information in [Örebro Vinterkubing - Main Events.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OrebroVinterkubingSideEvents2025#64743-orebro-vinterkubing-main-events) We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

[Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY) [Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/) • Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. • **ENGLISH** All competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) • We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted. [WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) • It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzAxNDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--6da5ef9073f639debc3933dfc87ec4d6f5f49d7c/1000179054.jpg)

Check back the day before the competition, as event durations may change depending on the number of competitors in events. ​ * Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance just in case ​ * We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called. ​ * Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations. ​ * Kindly bring your ID card while entering the campus. ​ * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. ​ * Participants must bring their own cubes. Happy cubing! :)
